prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, soft and heavy and slack; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, her waist lost beneath the folds, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight white liquid-satin mini skirt with its hem at mid-thigh and a slit cut up the left side to the upper thigh, paired with a minimal black leather harness bra of small molded triangle cups on thin crossing straps with silver ring hardware, the small opaque cups fully covering her bust, her stomach fully visible below it. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and slightly darker skin over her elbows. Pose: standing on the floor of the open gift box front-facing with her weight on one leg, both arms relaxed at her sides, chin lifted, looking straight at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy white satin, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy white satin with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

Background: a polished white table in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic red gift box with its lid lifted off, a huge satin ribbon bow in glossy gold, gigantic crinkled pink tissue paper spilling over the edges, giant confetti pieces on the table, a softly blurred party room far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall standing inside the open gift box with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright warm party light with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous gift box, ribbon bow and tissue paper around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
